title: US, Iran ceasefire will bring 'relief' but unclear 'what the future holds'

contentText: The two-week ceasefire agreed between the US, ISrael and Iran will bring relief for the international community and the Iranian population, Myriam Benraad, professor and Middle East specialist at the University of Exeter, tells France 24. But, with talks now set to take place to negotiate a longer-term peace and given the constradictory messages coming from the White House "we don't really know what the future holds", she says.
